### 2026-10-13 – I wasn't very happy with the rough mould I & "shape" trew together last time but rather than fix it I tried to improve the form  concepts to make it a bit better - tolerances and weep holes along with

**2h**

I wasn't very happy with the rough mould I & "shape" trew together last time but rather than fix it I tried to improve the form  concepts to make it a bit better - tolerances and weep holes along with guides to limit the compression to a desirable depth

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 22.38.11](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/3e08a7456e9ff1858abd9e2dfde9093e199145384925afc11ec8ed74985b92ed.png)

Then I made the github for this project and did some further more scientific research to find a few  science backed papers into the process and even stumbled across a way I  might be able to strengthen my final products with some CHEMISTRY!!! over the rest of the week I hope to mainly make a good mould even if it not the most complex shape and to create some test recipes based on the research I  have done so far.

![Screenshot 2026-10-13 at 23.34.34](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/7fbb15f8f2b71b409bbf634380a5c552ac760267da630be7a5cd279f33a62e8b.png)

**1.75h**

Lacking the time to do any real cad today I may have gotten side tracked by this project as a whole but I am invested so here goes my research
![Screenshot 2026-10-15 at 00.00.57](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/33ffa4babb687c628f76ed413ae5834ad4c43e5ef69a60b345e1fb140adc4005.png)

Continuing from my research from yesterday I spent a good bit going down a separate rabbit hole of using leaf litter as a fiber alternative - finding this to be a completely new take I read some further research on the subject and added it to my recipe list.

I hope to find more time tomorrow or Friday to finally make some nice moulds that I can at the very least fill with cardboard. I hope that this is not too far out of the project scope for the team but I am invested!

### 2026-10-18 – Finding the time to finally make my new moulds based off  all that I learned the previous week (from my first attempt and my research into the material properties and moulding process).  This lead me

**2.92h**

Finding the time to finally make my new moulds based off  all that I learned the previous week (from my first attempt and my research into the material properties and moulding process).  This lead me to the compliant wall mechanism that will hopefully make removing finished parts a breeze! I did then decide to make a second simple mould that acts as like a desk container just since I was then in the groove of working. This one I remembered hearing about the "Squircle." (a mix between a square and a circle that you might recognize from app icons) this  complex shape is meant to be pleasing to the eyes but after trying to get it with a reference image and fit point splines and it still looking off I turned to "Fusion AI" and colour me surprised it did exactly what I needed it to!  I will see how much I want to trust this in the future since I still very much enjoy the CAD process and am no way looking to replace myself.

### 2026-10-18 – After finishing the last two moulds earlier today I decided they could be further improved by trying to make them more parametric. This was obviously a bit dumb to only do after the fact so it meant a

**2.75h**

After finishing the last two moulds earlier today I decided they could be further improved by trying to make them more parametric. This was obviously a bit dumb to only do after the fact so it meant a lot of broken sketches and lost geometries but eventually I got it done!

![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 14.51.25](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/a1065de50f7df2b187441dffd27c52336936841fa2134187017c4bd0dac21429.png)

Then I made a second version of the Holder design which has one unrounded corner like my dray design for a little bit asymmetry.
![Screenshot 2026-10-18 at 18.43.42](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/afB45WLTnSAsFqrMq92IoTER2dLA2UXI/02bb320fcb8e5c2727ed33ad003e8bf8629dd7c19b43d2e6d754c7c6045fe705.png)

Then for both versions I thought they might do well with a lid so I made a second top piece (aka the press) that reuses the other 3 parts of the form (this might be a stretch if I actually use it because depending how tall the form is that would be a big hunk of wasted plastic).

And to finish off I took some nicer pictures of my parts and wrote the readme and BOM ( admittedly the least favorite parts of projects but very necessary I admit)
